summary: The iOS app reports the person's presence: present in the foreground, refreshed every 10 minutes, and idle when it leaves

schema.detail: No database, claim or client API change; the app uses the existing client-v0 availability operations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Reports go to POST /v1/client/presence; the 10-minute repeat sits between the daemon's 5-minute dedup window and its 15-minute staleness.

compatibility.detail: Pairings without write.presence and non-person sessions report nothing; a 403 stops reporting for that connection.

recovery.detail: A stale report ages out after 15 minutes; set a status override to ignore presence.
